title: 4.2 Reflections

icans: I can reflect a figure in the x-axis, the y-axis, or a horizontal or vertical line.
I can reflect a figure in y = x or y = −x.
I can perform a glide reflection and find lines of symmetry.

vocab: a _________________ that uses a line like a mirror to reflect a figure
the line that acts as the __________
a ______________ followed by a reflection in a line parallel to the direction of the translation
a figure has line symmetry when a _____________ maps the figure onto itself

blocks.p: Plot A(1, 2), B(4, 5), C(5, 1). Fold along each axis and record the images.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Reflections in the axes: in the x-axis, (x, y) → _______________; in the y-axis, (x, y) → _______________.

blocks.stem: Reflect △ABC in the x-axis, then (separately) in the y-axis. Give the vertices.
Reflect (5, 3) and (0, −1) in the line x = 2.

titles: Reflections in y = x and y = −x

blocks.stem: Reflect (3, −4) in the line y = x, then (separately) in the line y = −x.

notes: Glide reflection: a translation followed by a _______________ in a line parallel to the direction of the translation.

blocks.stem: Translate A(−3, 2) by (x, y) → (x + 4, y), then reflect in the x-axis. Find the final image.

notes: Line symmetry: a figure has line symmetry when a _______________ maps the figure onto itself.
